title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.21421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. translated_title: AuXSpec：通过可执行后置条件学习程序规范的自动形式化
translated_abstract: 形式化规范定义了程序的预期行为，并构成了程序验证的基础，但在诸如 Lean 这样的定理证明器中编写它们既缓慢又需要专业知识，这使得规范编写成为规模化产出形式正确代码的主要瓶颈。从自然语言问题出发的自动形式化很有前景，但训练规范模型需要对生成的规范是否捕捉了预期行为提供可扩展的反馈。先前的方法通过显式证明或带有形式对应性证明的单独实现代码来获得这种反馈，两者代价都很高。我们提出了 AuXSpec，这是一个 Lean 框架，它将声明式后置条件与可执行对应版本配对——在可能时通过类型类解析获得可执行版本，否则单独定义并提供等价性证明。随后，测试用例可以通过执行来评估声明式规范，使我们能够以规范间的一致性作为强化学习的奖励。利用 AuXSpec，我们合成了……
tldr: AuXSpec 通过在 Lean 中将声明式后置条件与可执行对应版本配对，使测试用例的执行一致性成为可扩展的强化学习奖励，从而低成本地训练程序规范的自动形式化模型。
en_tdlr: AuXSpec pairs declarative postconditions in Lean with executable counterparts, so test-case agreement can serve as a scalable reinforcement-learning reward for training autoformalization models of program specifications.
